Grand Theft Auto VI
New GTA drop living rent-free in the group chat? Same. With Jason and Lucia headed to Vice City, JB’s GTA 6 collection brings the hype in one place. Pre-orders are now live for PS5 and Xbox Series X download-code-in-box editions, ahead of the 19 November launch. Game night calling for Grand Theft Auto mayhem? Say less.
When is GTA VI released?
GTA VI launches on 19 November 2026.
Can I pre-order GTA VI at JB?
Yes. GTA VI pre-orders are now live at JB.
Does GTA VI come with pre-order DLC at JB?
Yes. Pre-order GTA VI at JB to receive the Vintage Vice City Pack. Offer ends 18 November 2026.
Which platforms is GTA VI available on at JB?
GTA VI is available for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S at JB.
Is GTA VI a physical disc?
No. This edition includes a download code in a box.
Does the GTA VI box include a disc?
No. The current boxed edition includes a download code, not a physical disc.
Is the GTA VI download code reusable?
No. The download code is single-use and non-transferable.
Do I need internet to install GTA VI from this edition?
Yes. You’ll need internet access to download the game using the code.
When can I pre-load GTA VI?
You can collect your GTA VI code-in-box edition pre-order from JB from 12 November. Use the code to download the game ahead of launch.
Who are the main characters in GTA 6?
Jason and Lucia.
Where is GTA 6 set?
GTA 6 is set in Vice City and the state of Leonida.
Is GTA 6 coming to PC?
No PC launch version has been announced yet.
